programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: George Ferribee, a loving son led astray by addiction, is found executed. When Lt. Joe Kenda learns the victim had recently been kidnapped, he assumes the crimes are related.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Spy Who Killed Me
programme.desc: Housewife Elsie Jennes is found dead in the basement of her burning home. Lt Joe Kenda has no leads until Elsie’s son, William, turns up in a police station over 50 miles away with a story to tell.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Killer Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: When 22 year-old Micki Filmore is found raped and murder in her apartment, detective Kenda focuses his investigation on her activities the previous night.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When a mysterious explosion rocks a sleepy suburb, it’s up to Kenda to ID a pile of charred remains and find the killer who triggered the blast.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Tortured Soul
programme.desc: A woman’s lifeless body is dumped on a lonely mountain pass. Leads are scarce, until a seemingly unrelated murder brings Kenda within arm’s reach of her killer.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Winter’s Nightmare

programme.title: Jury Room: Susan May
programme.desc: An elderly woman is murdered in her own bed and her niece and primary caregiver is arrested after incriminating forensic evidence is discovered, but did she, do it?

programme.title: Jury Room: Jack Whomes
programme.desc: Three members of a drug gang are shot and killed at point blank range. The Jury Room will debate the case of Jack Whomes, a ruthless killer or an innocent suffering a miscarriage of Justice?

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged

programme.title: iCarly: Et usædvanligt webshow
programme.desc: Efter Sam pludselig bliver tvunget i fængsel, lover Carly og Freddie ikke at aflyse netshowet, fordi hendes far skal se det. Hun beder Spencer om hjælp, men det bliver svært, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Rumvanvid
programme.desc: En pudsig milliardær beder Carly og hendes venner om at sende det første netshow fra rummet, så de bliver testet til en rumrejse. Imens besøger en mærkelig lille pige Spencer.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter hjemmefra
programme.desc: Freddie beslutter at flytte ud af sin lejlighed efter hans mor gør ham flov. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma, specialiserer sig i fotos af kæledyr.

programme.title: iCarly: Lejlighedsvisit
programme.desc: Da en hedebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til undsætning med et norsk klimaanlæg.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere
programme.desc: De medvirkende introducerer bloopers og smuttere fra serien.

programme.title: iCarly: iFik et varmt rum
programme.desc: Spencer forsøger at overraske Carly til hendes fødselsdag, men ender med at brænde hendes værelse ned. Men da forsikringen giver ham en stor check, får han mulighed for at gøre det godt igen.

programme.title: iCarly: iGør
programme.desc: Da en iCarly-fan frier til sin kæreste live i webshowet, bliver vennerne shanghajet til at komme til brylluppet. Men da bruden får kolde fødder, må Carly klarer ærterne.

programme.title: iCarly: iSælger penny-t-shirts
programme.desc: Vennerne kaster sig ud i at lave og sælge Penny-T-shits. Da salget går amok, hyrer Sam børn fra 4. til at hjælpe med at lave T-shirts. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om, hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: iLaver drengestreger
programme.desc: Da de andre driller Carly med, at hun aldrig har lavet fis, beder hun Spencer om hjælp med at lave fis med Sam og Freddie. Men da Spencer får smag for det, kan han ikke stoppe igen. Vennerne må finde en måde at stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: iSams mor
programme.desc: Efter et skænderi med sin mor flytter Sam ind hos Carly, som snart indser, at hun er en forfærdelig gæst. Freddie forfølges af en farlig forbryder, da han har fanget ham på fersk gerning på video.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremiere af komedieprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key at sige et forbudt ord om deres kvinder, Lil Wayne vænner sig til livet bag tremmer og præsident Obama udtrykker, hvad han virkelig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meagan's Fight
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer, at Meagan vender tilbage, Jordan prøver at se cool ud på en stripklub og optræder med et funkshow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer gangstere, der er vilde med 'Twilight,' besøg til en verden, hvor navnene er prutter og racistiske superhelte.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Michael Jackson Halloween
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Biological Dad
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer et rumvæsen, der lærer om kvindelig anatomi, fyrene der prøver at overgå hinanden og mødet mellem de to sidste mennesker på Jorden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Killer Concept Album
programme.desc: En politiker benægter at have sendt frække fotos, en detektiv forhører en rapper, Cedric og Levi finder lyn i en flaske, to herrer fra Syden komplimenterer kvinder, Jordan møder en gammel ven og en betjent tager tingene bogstaveligt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2
programme.desc: Sketcherne inkluderr en introduktion af de nyeste East/West Bowl-spillere, udlejer-Devon ransager Jordans lejlighed, og Jordan bliver stødt af en overseksuel kollega.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn, der glæder sig over fordelene ved deres nu lovlige ægteskab, en politibetjent, der møder sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' bliver forfulgt af en superfan.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for at besøge Abbis barndomshjem . Da Abbi indser, at hun begik en stor fejl i high school, tager hun og Ilana ud på en forsoningsmission.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana lægger deres lejligheder ud på B & B-NYC for at tjene lidt ekstra penge.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas forældre kommer til byen til deres 30-års jubilæum, men Abbi og Ilana synes, det er svært at fejre, når de begge har samlivsproblemer.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana skal ud at rejse, men det er sværere at komme i lufhavnen end forventet.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
